definitions.explanation: A small mesh strainer used to filter tea leaves when pouring brewed tea. Sometimes built into the spout of a {急須|きゅうす} (Japanese teapot).

examples.japanese: {茶漉|ちゃこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{茶葉|ちゃば}→茶葉：15508_chaba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{湯飲|ゆの}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らない→入る：00494_hairu⟧よう、{茶漉|ちゃこ}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧こした。
examples.english: I strained the tea so no leaves would get into the cup.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{急須|きゅうす}→急須：04980_kyuusu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{茶漉|ちゃこ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{内蔵|ないぞう}→内蔵：30075_naizou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: This teapot is convenient because the strainer is built into it.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (tea) + {漉|こ}し (the noun form of ⟦{漉|こ}す→漉す：13512_kosu⟧, "to strain"). Refers to either a handheld strainer or one built into a teapot.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶漉|ちゃこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a tea strainer
- {茶漉|ちゃこ}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧こす: to strain with a tea strainer
- {茶漉|ちゃこ}し⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦{急須|きゅうす}→急須：04980_kyuusu⟧: teapot with a built-in strainer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{急須|きゅうす}→急須：04980_kyuusu⟧: Japanese teapot — often has a {茶漉|ちゃこ}し built into the spout
- ティース⟦トレーナー→トレーナー：21469_toreenaa⟧: tea strainer (loanword) — same thing, used more in Western-style tea contexts
- ⟦ざる→ざる：04470_zaru⟧: mesh basket strainer — for food, not tea
